examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
tadahu pabbajito santo, jātiyā sattavassiko, so'pi maṃ anusāseyya, sampaṭicchāmi matthake.

29801.meaning1: born that very day; born the same day

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.

29803.meaning1: on that observance day; that being the observance day

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.

29804.meaning1: which appeared on that same day; which becomes available on that very day

examples.text: tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya satiyā'pi paccāsāyā'ti tadah'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, yadā kāyaṃ jahant'imaṃ, apaviddho tadā seti, parabhattaṃ acetanaṃ.
dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

29807.meaning1: came there; arrived there; (or) came then
29807.commentary: (DNa) āpo ca devā pathavī, tejo vāyo tadāgamun'ti āpokasiṇ'ādīsu parikammaṃ katvā nibbattā āpo'ti-ādi-nāmakā devā āgamuṃ.

examples.text: āpo ca devā pathavī, tejo vāyo tadāgamuṃ, varuṇā vāraṇā devā, somo ca yasasā saha.

29808.meaning1: doing that; performing that; engaging in that
29808.commentary: (SNa) mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti evaṃ dhammakathaṃ ācaranto mā laggi.

examples.text: n'etaṃ tava patirūpaṃ, yadaññam'anusāsasi, anurodhavirodhesu, mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti.

29809.meaning1: gets at that time; obtains then; (comm) gets that

examples.text: yaṃ gihissa'pi tadatthajotakaṃ, pabbajjam'pi ca tad'ādhigacchati, khajjabhojjarasalābhi'r'uttamaṃ, āhu sabbagihibandhanacchidan'ti.

29810.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

29811.meaning1: (aiming at) that good result; with that benefit (in mind); (comm) benefit of arahantship

examples.text: bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, ākaṅkhe ce hadayass'ānupattiṃ, lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañ'ca, sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃso'ti.

29812.meaning1: right then; even at that time

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso yamaka, yadā hi so puriso amuṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ āha, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti, tadā'pi so vadhako'va, vadhakañ'ca pana santaṃ na aññāsi, vadhako me'ti.
tadā'pi me, bhikkhave, amanāpā nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa mantaṃ vācetuṃ, kim'aṅga pana eta'r'ahi na amanāpā bhavissati nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ.

29813.meaning1: that dimension; that field; that base
29813.commentary: (MNa) tadāyatanan'ti taṃ āyatanaṃ, paramassāsabhāvena patiṭṭhānabhūtaṃ arahattan'ti attho. (UDa) tadāyatanan'ti taṃ kāraṇaṃ. dakāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, tadāyatanaṃ, yattha n'eva pathavī, na āpo, na tejo, na vāyo, na ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ, na viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ, na ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ, na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ, n'āyaṃ loko, na paraloko, na ubho candimasūriyā.
kudāssu nām'āhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā eta'r'ahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī'ti iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ.

29815.meaning1: with that as its object; based on that
29815.meaning2: having that (aforesaid thing) as its object

examples.text: tañ'ca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma, tadārammaṇañ'ca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cittena vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharissāmā'ti.

29816.meaning2: (abhi) registration (consciousness, which has the same object as the javana that preceded it in the citta-vīthi)

29817.meaning1: then there was; at time there was
29817.commentary: (DNa) tadā'sī'ti saha parinibbānā mahābhūmicālo'ti evaṃ heṭṭhā vuttaṃ bhūmicālam'eva sandhāy'āha. tañ'hi lomahaṃsanañ'ca bhiṃsanakañ'ca āsi.

examples.text: tadā'si yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadā'si lomahaṃsanaṃ, sabb'ākāra-var'ūpete, sambuddhe parinibbute'ti.
tadāsu devā maññanti, tāvatiṃsā sah'indakā, yv'āyaṃ mama pallaṅkasmiṃ, sv'āyaṃ eko'va bhāsatī'ti.

29819.grammar: aor 3rd pl of tadāsi, comp vb (+nom)

examples.text: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.

29820.commentary: (APAa) tato paraṃ vissajjit'ākāraṃ dassento tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī, ānandabhaddaṃ madhurassarena, ye pubbabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā, aladdhamokkhā jinasāsanesu.

29821.meaning1: feeding on that; with that nutriment

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
atha kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā rasapathaviṃ paribhuñjantā taṃbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

29822.meaning1: ending of that sustenance; cessation of that fuel

examples.text: bhūtam'idan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhārasambhavan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.

29823.meaning1: produced by that fuel; generated by that sustenance
29823.commentary: (MNa) tadāhārasambhavan'ti taṃ pan'etaṃ khandhapañcakaṃ āhārasambhavaṃ paccayasambhavaṃ, sati paccaye uppajjati evaṃ passathā'ti pucchati.

examples.text: bhūtam'idan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhārasambhavan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

29824.grammar: perf 3rd pl of tadāha, comp vb

examples.text: nabhañ'ca dūre pathavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tadāhu dūre, yato ca verocano abbhudeti, pabhaṅ'karo yattha ca atthameti, tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti, satañ'ca dhammaṃ asatañ'ca dhammaṃ.
yassa devā pitaro ca sabbe, sarīsapā sabbabhūtāni c'āpi, mettāya niccaṃ apacitāni honti, bhūtesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.

29825.meaning1: please… that!; pray… that!; come now… that!
29825.commentary: (SNPa) tadiṅgha brūhī'ti taṃ mayā pucchitamatthaṃ brūhi yācāmi taṃ ahan'ti. yācan'attho hi iṅghā'ti nipāto.

examples.text: kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.
kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca, khandhe ime'haṃ amite ca dhamme, ajjhattikān'eva ca bāhirāni ca, samaṃ tuleyyaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

29828.commentary: (VINt) tato uttariṃ taduttariṃ, tassa tassa vuttappamāṇato atirekaṃ.

examples.text: saṅgh'ādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantānaṃ ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ, dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti. dve tayo ekato samanubhāsitabbā, taduttari na samanubhāsitabbā.

29829.meaning1: come to that; arrived at that; (comm) come then

examples.text: te tattha mante ganthetvā, okkākaṃ tadupāgamuṃ, pahūtadhanadhañño'si, yajassu bahu te vittaṃ, yajassu bahu te dhanaṃ.
svāgataṃ na durāgataṃ, na'y'idaṃ dumantitaṃ mama, saṃvibhattesu dhammesu, yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tadupāgamin'ti.

29830.commentary: (MNa) tathāgato tadupātivatto'ti taṃ saṅkhataṃ atikkanto samatikkanto'ti attho. (MNa) tadupātivatto'ti taṃ diṭṭhiṃ atikkanto.

examples.text: n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ. ta'y'idaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho atth'etan'ti, iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.

29831.meaning1: clinging to that; grasping that; attached to that

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, imañ'ce ahaṃ upekkhaṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasaṃhareyyaṃ, tadanudhammañ'ca cittaṃ bhāveyyaṃ, evaṃ me ayaṃ upekkhā taṃnissitā tadupādānā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.

tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. yā vedanāsu nandī tadupādānaṃ, tass'upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti.

29832.meaning1: on account of that; dependent on that

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ. tasmiṃ sati, tadupādāya, evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati, na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā'ti.

29833.meaning1: suitable for that; appropriate for that

examples.text: tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā thālipākasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so thālipāko hoti yato nāḷik'odanaparamaṃ bhuñjāmi tadupiyañ'ca sūpeyyaṃ.
majjhimo nāma patto nāḷik'odanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
anattamanatā ca attamanatā ca, tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.

29837.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of tadubhaya

examples.text: tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.

29838.meaning2: fit for that, appropriate for that

29839.commentary: (JAa) bhekavaṇṇā tadūbhayan'ti te ubho'pi āmā ca pakkā ca maṇḍūkapiṭṭhivaṇṇāy'eva.

examples.text: yathā aññataraṃ bījaṃ, khette vuttaṃ virūhati, pathavīrasañ'c'āgamma, sinehañ'ca tadūbhayaṃ.
aññ'ettha pupphitā ambā, aññe tiṭṭhanti dovilā, aññe āmā ca pakkā ca, bhekavaṇṇā tadūbhayaṃ.

29840.meaning1: connected with that; combined with that
29840.meaning2: standing together with that, conjoined with that
29840.commentary: (THIa) tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave'ti rāgadosehi sahaj'ekaṭṭhe pahān'ekaṭṭhe ca tatiyamaggavajjhe āsave pahāsiṃ samucchindiṃ.

examples.text: sikkhamānā ahaṃ santī, bhāventī maggam'añjasaṃ, pahāsiṃ rāgadosañ'ca, tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave.

sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu, aho rasaṃ, aho rasan'ti! tadeta'r'ahi'pi manussā kañci'd'eva surasaṃ labhitvā evam'āhaṃsu, aho rasaṃ, aho rasan'ti! tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti, na tv'ev'assa atthaṃ ājānanti.

29842.meaning1: just that; the same thing; that very thing; that itself

examples.text: yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.
yadeva tvaṃ, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo ahosi, tadeva te kāyakammaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
evam'eva pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ poṭṭhapādo yaññad'eva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati, taṃ tadev'assa abbhanumodati, evam'etaṃ bhagavā evam'etaṃ, sugatā'ti.

29844.meaning1: just that I; that very thing I

examples.text: yattha ca pana na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati tadev'āhaṃ vadāmi, idañ'hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjatī'ti.

29845.meaning1: in some specific; in a certain

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tadev'ekaccesu janapadesu, pātī'ti sañjānanti, pattan'ti sañjānanti, vittan'ti sañjānanti, sarāvan'ti sañjānanti, dhāropan'ti sañjānanti, poṇan'ti sañjānanti, pisīlavan'ti sañjānanti.

29846.commentary: (DNa) taddiguṇaṃ taddiguṇ'āhan'ti tato tato diguṇaṃ diguṇaṃ ahaṃ karissāmi, bhagavatā saddhiṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ kātuṃ asamatthabhāvaṃ jānanto'pi uttamapurisena saddhiṃ paṭṭhapetvā asakkuṇantassā'pi pāsaṃso hotī'ti ñatvā evam'āha. nagaravāsino'pi taṃ sutvā asamattho nāma evaṃ na gajjati, addhā ayam'pi arahā bhavissatī'ti tassa mahantaṃ sakkāram'akaṃsu.

examples.text: iti yāvatakaṃ yāvatakaṃ samaṇo gotamo uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, taddiguṇaṃ taddiguṇ'āhaṃ karissāmī'ti.

29848.meaning1: (gram) secondary derivative affix added to nouns to form derived nouns and adjectives

examples.text: tesaṃgahaṇena samāsataddhita-ākhyātakitakānaṃ vibhattipaccayapad'akkhar'āgamā ca lopā honti. vāsiṭṭho, venateyyo
evaṃ liṅga, sabbanāma, pada, upasagga, nipāta, taddhita, ākhyāta, kammappavacanīy'ādisaññā ca.

29852.meaning1: (gram) √tan etc.; group 7 roots which take the conjugational sign o & yira

examples.text: 451, 520. tanādito o yirā.

29853.meaning1: (gram) √tan etc. group; group 7 roots which take the conjugational sign o & yira

examples.text: gaṇato te aṭṭhavidhā bhū'v'ādigaṇo rudh'ādigaṇo div'ādigaṇo sv'ādigaṇo kiy'ādigaṇo gah'ādigaṇo tan'ādigaṇo cur'ādigaṇo cā'ti.

29856.commentary: (ITIa) tanū saṃyojanā hontī'ti mettājhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā sammasitvā heṭṭhime ariyamagge adhigacchantassa sukhen'eva paṭighasaṃyojan'ādayo pahīyamānā tanū honti… atha vā tanū saṃyojanā hontī'ti mettājhānapadaṭṭhānāya vipassanāya anukkamena upadhikkhayasaṅkhātaṃ arahattaṃ patvā taṃ passato pag'eva dasa'pi saṃyojanā tanū honti, pahīyantī'ti attho. atha vā tanū saṃyojanā hontī'ti paṭigho c'eva paṭighasampayuttasaṃyojanā ca tanukā honti.

examples.text: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
yo ca mettaṃ bhāvayati, appamāṇaṃ paṭissato, tanū saṃyojanā honti, passato upadhikkhayaṃ.
andhabhūto ayaṃ loko, tanuko-ettha vipassati, sakuṇo jālamutto'va, appo saggāya gacchati.
manujassa sadā satīmato, mattaṃ jānato laddhabhojane, tanukassa bhavanti vedanā, saṇikaṃ jīrati āyupālayan'ti.

29866.commentary: (DNa) tanuttā'ti pariyuṭṭhānamandatāya ca kadāci karahaci uppattiyā ca tanubhāvā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino saki'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakiṃ'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.

29867.commentary: (DNa) tanuttā'ti pariyuṭṭhānamandatāya ca kadāci karahaci uppattiyā ca tanubhāvā.

29868.commentary: (MNa) tanupattapalāso'ti na abbhapaṭalaṃ viya tanupaṇṇo, viraḷapaṇṇattaṃ pan'assa sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāriputta, rukkho visame bhūmibhāge jāto tanupattapalāso kabaracchāyo. atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva rukkhaṃ paṇidhāya.

taṃ tattha suvānadoṇiyaṃ suvānapiṇḍam'iva dantamusalehi koṭṭetvā jivhāya samparivattiyamānaṃ jivh'āgge tanupasannakheḷo makkheti, vemajjhato paṭṭhāya bahalakheḷo makkheti, dantakaṭṭhena asampattaṭṭhāne dantagūthako makkheti.
atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, kiṃ nu kho, ānanda, tanubhūto viya bhikkhusaṅgho'ti?

29872.commentary: (SNa) tanuyā'ti tanukā, hiriyā akusale dhamme nisedhetvā carantā khīṇ'āsavā nāma appakā'ti attho.

examples.text: hirīnisedhā tanuyā, ye caranti sadā satā, antaṃ dukkhassa pappuyya, caranti visame saman'ti.
tanu'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato o yira'icc'ete paccayā honti kattari. tanoti, tanohi, karoti, karohi, kayirati, kayirāhi.
yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

taṇhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi jāliniṃ saritaṃ visaṭaṃ visattikaṃ, yāya ayaṃ loko uddhasto pariyonaddho tant'ākulakajāto gulāguṇṭhikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya

29883.meaning1: like a tangled ball of thread
29883.meaning2: entangled like a ball of string
29883.commentary: (ANa) tantākulakajāto'ti tantaṃ viya ākulajāto. yathā nāma dunnikkhittaṃ mūsikacchinnaṃ pesakārānaṃ tantaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ ākulaṃ hoti, idaṃ aggaṃ idaṃ mūlan'ti aggena vā aggaṃ, mūlena vā mūlaṃ samānetuṃ dukkaraṃ hoti, evaṃ sattā imāya taṇhāya pariyonaddhā ākulabyākulā na sakkonti attano nissaraṇamaggaṃ ujuṃ kātuṃ.

examples.text: taṇhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi jāliniṃ saritaṃ visaṭaṃ visattikaṃ, yāya ayaṃ loko uddhasto pariyonaddho tant'ākulakajāto gulāguṇṭhikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

29884.meaning1: woven on the loom; (or) woven with thread
29884.commentary: (ANa) tant'āvutānaṃ vatthānan'ti paccatte sāmivacanaṃ, tantehi vāyitavatthānī'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici tant'āvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ, kesakambalo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati. kesakambalo, bhikkhave, sīte sīto, uṇhe uṇho, dubbaṇṇo, duggandho, dukkhasamphasso.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati, seyyath'idaṃ, doṇiñ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca daṇḍañ'ca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca ev'āyaṃ, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.
diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

29889.commentary: (THIa) tamh'uddhaṭe tantikhīlake'ti sannivesa-visiṭṭha-racanā-visesa-yuttaṃ upādāya rūpakasamaññā tamhi tantimhi khīlake ca ṭhānato uddhaṭe

examples.text: tamh'uddhaṭe tantikhīlake, vissaṭṭhe vikale parikrite, na vindeyya khaṇḍaso kate, kimhi tattha manaṃ nivesaye.

29890.commentary: (DNt) tantidhammaṃ nāma kathento'ti yesaṃ atthāya dhammo kathīyati, tasmiṃ tesaṃ asati'pi maggapaṭivedhe kevalaṃ sāsane tantidhammaṃ katvā kathento.

examples.text: yasmā imasmiṃ dhammapariyāye idh'attho'pi par'attho'pi vibhatto, tasmā't'iha tvaṃ imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, yasmā pan'ettha bahū tantidhammā kathitā, tasmā dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi
yo dhamme pasādo'ti aniyyānikasāsanasmiñ'hi dhamme pasādo nāma, uggahitapariyāpuṭa, dhāritavācittamattake tantidhamme pasādo hoti, vaṭṭamokkho pan'ettha n'atthi.

29894.meaning1: sound of a string; tone of a string
29894.meaning2: string of music, sound of lute

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agāriyabhūto vīṇāya tantissare'ti?

29895.commentary: (SNa) tandī'ti atisīt'ādipaccayā uppannaṃ āgantukakāy'ālasiyaṃ. (VIBH) tattha katamā tandī? yā tandī tandiyanā tandimanakatā ālasyaṃ ālasyāyanā ālasyāyitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati tandī.

examples.text: kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

29896.meaning1: having that view; holding that opinion; with that belief

29898.commentary: (SNa) tandī'ti aticchāt'ādi-vasena āgantukālasiyaṃ. (VIBH) tattha katamā tandī? yā tandī tandiyanā tandimanakatā ālasyaṃ ālasyāyanā ālasyāyitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati tandī.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannaṃ vā thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, arati tandī vijambhikā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ
niddaṃ tandiṃ vijambhitaṃ, aratiṃ bhattasammadaṃ, vīriyena naṃ paṇāmetvā, ariyamaggo visujjhatī'ti.

29899.meaning1: on account of that; because of that

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ kāyaduccaritasamaṅgī tan'nidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya. n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
